Net margin for fiscal 2023 is net income divided by total revenue, taking each company's net income as reported.

**Pfizer:** Net income attributable to Pfizer common shareholders was $2,119M on revenue of $59,553M, a margin of 3.558%. Using net income before noncontrolling interests ($2,158M) gives 3.62%.

**Johnson & Johnson:** Net earnings were $35,153M on sales of $85,159M, a margin of 41.28%. This figure includes $21,827M from discontinued operations (the Kenvue separation). Net earnings from continuing operations alone were $13,326M, a margin of 15.65%.

I used total net earnings as reported, since the 2023 figures were not recast to exclude discontinued operations. On that basis J&J leads by 41.28 − 3.56 = 37.72 percentage points.

**Johnson & Johnson had the higher fiscal 2023 net margin, by about 37.7 percentage points.**
